priorityList: Summon your pet and use Wildfire Bomb before combat begins.
Use offensive cooldowns, racial abilities, and trinkets when Takedown is active or its cooldown is ready.
Use Kill Command if you have no stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Use Kill Command if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear and any Pack Leader buffs (Wyvern, Boar, or Bear) are active.
Cast Takedown when you have Tip of the Spear stacks (or at 0 stacks if the Twin Fangs talent is taken).
Cast Wildfire Bomb if you are about to reach maximum charges to avoid capping.
Use Boomstick while Tip of the Spear is active.
Cast Wildfire Bomb when Tip of the Spear is active.
Use Moonlight Chakram when Tip of the Spear is active.
Cast Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) to refresh the Raptor Swipe cleave buff or if Tip of the Spear is active.
Use Kill Command as a filler to generate Focus and Tip of the Spear stacks.
Use Wildfire Bomb as a filler if no higher priority actions are available.
Cast Takedown as a filler if it is available.
Use Aspect of the Eagle if you are forced out of melee range of your target.
